batting.dismissal: c LRPL Taylor b UT Yadav

batting.dismissal: c UT Yadav b IK Pathan

batting.name: NV Ojha
batting.dismissal: c Harbhajan Singh b RP Singh

balls.text: it's all over, at least the Mumbai innings is. Ojha backed away to a full delivery and tried to hit over the off side. The ball was too full for that shot, and it crashed into middle stump.
short of a length and straight, defended back to the bowler
Munaf backs away toward leg and gets beaten outside off

Ojha fends a short of a length ball off his body and runs a single that is risky for Munaf, who would have been out by a long way if the fielder running in from square leg had connected with his underarm throw
a slower ball outside off stump, Munaf backs away again and dabs towards backward point
Munaf backs away towards the leg side and tries to cut, he gets beaten
dug out from the blockhole towards short cover
a fumble at backward point allows the single
a yorker, and the batsman manages to play towards mid-on
Harbhajan's free-swinging innings is over. He tried to pull a short of a length ball and edged it to the wicketkeeper.
Morkel sprays it wide outside off stump
the attempted yorker ends up as a low full toss, Harbhajan leans towards the off, gets under the ball and swats it flat towards the midwicket boundary for a one-bounce four
in the blockhole, Ojha manages to dig it out and place it towards third man
a full ball, searing past the off stump after Ojha chose to stay in his crease and try and push on the off side
good length and straight, Ojha is caught on the crease and has to defend
a slow ball outside off, Harbhajan swings across the line too early and makes no contact
another short ball, but it was too high, the keeper jumped up but could only slow the ball down
a full ball slanting across the right-hander, Ojha gets beaten while trying to drive
Ojha tries to chip a short ball over the keeper and slip, but he makes no contact
beaten outside the off stump by a full and fast ball
hit towards the fielder on the cover boundary
that's just short of a length and Umesh beats Harbhajan's attempt at pulling with his brisk pace
Ojha gets beaten by one in the blockhole outside off stump

the off stump has been detonated from the ground! Morkel went for the full and straight option, RP Singh chose to back away towards leg and swish. He missed and the ball cannoned into the base of off stump, uprooting it, while leaving middle and leg stump intact with the bail on top.
RP Singh stands in his crease and slogs, trying to hit the ball from five feet outside off towards the leg side, Morkel's too quick for him
short ball, RP Singh swings towards the leg side, and he gets beaten
in the blockhole on off and middle stump, dug out by the batsman
worked off the pads behind square, not very fluently
played towards the leg side for a single, there was two there if Harbhajan wanted it, but he wanted the strike more
caught at long off! McKay tries to launch over long-off but doesn't hit it far enough, Umesh Yadav positions himself for the catch and tumbles to the ground after taking it
hard to tell if that was a slower ball, McKay drives to Umesh at long off, the throw to the keeper's end is not very good and Mumbai get an overthrow
full ball outside off, McKay drives but Mahela's in the way at short cover
McKay guides the ball from his crease towards backward point
good length and straight, Harbhajan stays in his crease and hits on the leg side
defended from the crease
punched off the back foot towards long off
another late cut, this time to short third man
defended from the crease
a little width outside off and Harbhajan cuts the ball very late, using the pace to squirt the ball fine of short third man
pushed off the back foot towards long-on
played from the crease towards point
edged, but wide of the diving wicketkeeper. There was width outside off and Harbhajan chased it, he even times his edges well
played towards third man

Harbhajan walks a long way out of his crease and gets hit on the back boot by a full ball angling into him. That looks close but Irfan's appeal is turned down. That hit him on the full so it looked a good shout. Harbhajan is lucky, but he was a long way out of his crease
tucked off the pads through square leg
a full ball on off and middle, McKay stays in his crease and drives to short cover
shades of Agarkar here, Harbhajan cuts now, hitting the ball off the front foot with impeccable timing to the third man boundary
another length ball and Harbhajan attacks again, smashing the ball past mid-on this time, that raced across the turf
Harbhajan's teed off with success! He lined up a length delivery and swung hard, launching the ball over long off. Harbhajan has awesome timing
full and straight, McKay drives towards Irfan at long off
short ball, Harbhajan moves across and swats towards Taylor at deep backward square
short of a length outside off, punched off the back foot through cover point
punched off the back foot towards third man
the yorker, played back to the bowler
that nearly bowled him, so close to off stump, the full and fast ball raced past the forward push
that's too full to be playing back to, but the batsman does, prodding outside off, and he is beaten

the implosion continues. Karthik was back in his crease and tried to pull a short of a length ball that hurried on to him. The lack of time to play the shot resulted in the ball lobbing to Pietersen at mid-on. Easy catch.
Harbhajan gets squared up by a short of a length ball and ends up hitting it awkwardly from wide outside off stump, he was trying to hit towards leg but got a leading edge towards cover
played towards long off for a single
defended on the back foot towards cover point
punched off the front foot in front of point

caught at deep backward square. Mumbai are a shambles tonight. Rohit's top-edged another one and this time it's to a fielder. Rohit was trying to tuck the ball off his hips, the extra bounce resulted in a top edge, and Taylor came running in from the boundary once again. So many top-edges off Rohit's bat went for four, not this one
tight, wicket to wicket line, Rohit defends from his crease
length ball outside off, steered towards third man
a full and fast ball outside off stump, some movement away from the right-hander and it beats the batsman
played to third man for a single
short ball and Rohit helps it around the corner towards fine leg

caught by Taylor, running in from the cover boundary! Pollard stayed in his crease, backed away towards leg and slogged hard, slicing the ball high in the air. Not too sure where he was trying to hit that, but it landed in Taylor's safe hands.
Rohit winds up to whack a good length delivery but ends up mis-timing it over the bowler's head, the fielder at mid-on runs to his left to field
good length and straight, Rohit stays in his crease and plays towards point
Pollard prods outside off stump and is beaten
strays down leg side, that's a wide
another mix up, the batsman played towards point, the non-striker began running but then turned back
Rohit has a golden top edge today. That's the third one he's hit to the boundary. Once again he tried to pull but top edged the ball to the third man boundary, that almost went for six
defended from the crease
another close call! Pollard pushed off the front foot towards cover and then set off. Rohit didn't want the single, so Pollard stopped, turned and dived to make his ground.

and he's struck, first ball. Well Delhi have anyway, through a run-out. Agarkar hit Rayudu on the pad with one that angled into the right-hander. The batsman set off for a leg bye, Rohit sent him back. Nagar missed the first throw at the stumps but Rayudu was so far out that the fielder backing up still had time to throw to the striker's end
the yorker follows two short balls, Rohit is ready though, and defends
another short ball, angling into the right-hander, Rohit drops his wrists and sways out of the way, watching the ball as it passes him
another top edge, and again it soars over the wicketkeeper for a one-bounce four. Morkel bounced Rohit, who was coming down the pitch to try and pull
Rayudu waits in his crease and dabs the ball behind point once again
nearly in the blockhole from Morkel, Rohit plays it towards midwicket
played from the crease behind point
Rohit moves outside leg stump and simply lofts the ball inside out over extra cover, all timing in that shot
steps out of his crease to slog the ball over the leg side but mis-hits through square leg
fired down leg side

tremendous effort from Mahela, but he's dropped it. Rayudu came out to a flighted ball and blasted it flat towards short cover, where Mahela timed his jump perfectly but couldn't catch the ball just over his head. That was hit very hard.
Rohit hits off the back foot towards cover, the placement is slightly wide of the fielder so there is a single
tight wicket to wicket line, the batsman goes back and plays to cover
pushed off the back foot on the off side
short ball outside off, Rayudu has a fish but catches nothing, he was trying to dab to third man
a quick short ball, Rayudu manages to sway out of the way, that would have hit him otherwise
good length outside off, Rohit pushes off the front foot towards point and runs. The throw from Nagar hits Rayudu on the leg. He's hobbling. That hit him on the calf.
edged and four! Rohit swings across the line, the ball wasn't short enough to hit over midwicket, the top edge screams over the keeper
shot! Rohit backs away towards leg, creates room, and drives a length ball over the infield at cover
good length outside off stump, driven from the crease towards cover point
quick and straight, defended from the crease on the off side, Nadeen is zipping through some stingy overs
full ball on off stump, driven from the crease to cover
defended on the front foot
a straight ball on off and middle, played from the crease towards wide mid-off
he steps out of his crease and drives fluently to long-off
he's bowled another batsman! Levi's gone, slogging across the line at a straight one delivered from round the wicket and inside-edging on to his stumps.
played to the fielder on the edge of the circle at midwicket
that ball is not coming back into the right-hander, it's slanting across, Rohit steps out and aims for midwicket, and gets beaten
Rohit strides forward and drives straight, Pathan dives to his right and deflects the ball towards mid-on
played from the crease towards mid-off, KP comes running in but can't prevent the run
Levi plonks a foot forward and tries to slog across the line, he gets hit on the pad by a full ball but that was missing leg
Pathan bends the ball back into Sharma, who plays on the leg side
pushed off the front foot towards mid-on, first runs off the bat

bowled him! Jacobs slogs across the line and gets beaten by the quicker ball that goes on with the arm from round the wicket. That hit the top of middle. Real ugly slog that was. No runs off the bat so far and Mumbai are a wicket down already.
backs away to hit through the off side but can't get past cover
Jacobs slogs across the line and gets beaten outside off, the keeper whips off the bails and appeals for a stumping, the batsman is safe
defended on the front foot towards point
beats Jacobs with the turn away from the right-hander from round the wicket, the batsman came forward to defend

Jacobs walks out of his crease and aims for the hoick over midwicket, he misses and is hit on the pad. Irfan appeals for lbw but Jacobs was yards out of his crease. Another leg bye, on the off side this time
length ball outside off, punched off the front foot to cover point
big swing across the line but Jacobs gets beaten by the movement into him
length ball and it swings in to the middle of Jacobs's bat, he hits it hard into the ground and Mahela leaps at cover to intercept the ball
full and outside off, Jacobs swings but is miles from the ball
Pathan gets the ball to bend back into the right-hander, hits Levi on the pad for a leg bye on the leg side
Taylor collects the winning runs by dabbing towards third man, Pollard bowled that off a short run, so he wasn't wasting any energy either
a slower ball delivered from wide of the crease, tapped towards mid on
a third wide in the over, outside off this time
played on the leg side for a single towards square
fuller length but the line is down leg side again
this time the keeper appeals for a catch after Taylor tries to hook a bouncer and gets beaten
that's wide down leg side, Karthik moves quickly to collect
Taylor tries to cut one that kicks off from a good length close to off stump, Pollard appeals for a catch behind
played behind point for a quick single
short ball, a quick one, Taylor moves across and pulls the ball down through midwicket, like a tennis smash of sorts, hitting it hard and through the gap
good length and straight, Taylor gets forward and behind the line to block
Mahela dabs the ball close on the leg side and runs quickly
good length outside off, Mahela gets beaten trying to fend outside off
short of a length at the body, fended down on the leg side
defended on the back foot
Mahela waits, and dabs very late past the keeper
dabbed with an open face towards point. Mahela sprints, Taylor hesitates, and then sprints in the end
clipped off the pads in front of square and Taylor runs hard to complete the second
Mahela swats the ball behind square

Levi's caught Sehwag, but too late perhaps? Sehwag charged Ojha again, and once again did not get to the pitch of the ball. He swung hard, trying to hit a straight six, but ended up lofting the ball extremely high in the air. Levi settled under the catch at long-on and judged it well
sublime, Mahela leans towards the off side and clips a straighter ball gracefully off his pads to the backward square leg boundary
Mahela prods at one outside off again but gets beaten once again by the away movement
the slower ball flicked off the pads through square
Mahela tries to slog over the leg side but gets an inside edge on to the pad, Mahela had charged down the pitch so he continued running after the ball rolled towards the off
pushes tentatively outside off stump and gets beaten by the movement away from the right-hander
Sehwag played back to a full ball and pushed it towards cover for a quick single
Sehwag stays in his crease and paddles the ball around the corner, the keeper goes after it
makes room by moving towards leg once again and cuts in front of point
he was into position for the sweep rather early and had to wait before lapping the ball towards short fine leg
Mahela makes room by moving towards leg and chips the ball just over the fielder runnign back at extra cover, he connected with the bottom of the bat
Sehwag steps out, isn't to the pitch of the ball again, but manages to slap it through cover
Sehwag goes back and hits the ball towards Levi at long on
short of a length at the body, Sehwag moves towards the off side and lifts his front leg off the ground as he tucks the ball towards deep backward square
driven on the front foot through cover
Sehwag sits back in his crease and cuts, hitting the ball fine and hard towards third man, Levi sprints to his left and dives to prevent the boundary
driven on the front foot towards Harbhajan's left at mid-off
Mahela closed the face too early and got a leading edge that lobbed in the air but short of the fielder at mid-on

good length on off and middle, pushed towards the off side for a quick single, Rohit sprinted in from extra cover but his throw missed at the striker's end, Mahela would have been dismissed by a direct hit
Ojha loops the ball into the right-hander from over the wicket, he has to pick it up on his follow through after Mahela defends
stays in his crease and defends on the off side
flighted outside off, played back to the bowler
Mahela moves forward and drives the ball towards the bowler's left
Sehwag steps out, is beaten in the flight again, and works the ball off his pads through midwicket
Sehwag gets behind the line and defends

caught at midwicket! The pull shot isn't a good one to try on this pitch. Pietersen is hurried and cramped for room by the short of a length ball, he ends up swatting it straight to Jacobs, who barely had to move
Sehwag stays back and opens the face, to steer the ball bending into him towards third man, along the ground this time
full ball outside off stump, Sehwag stays in his crease and drives, beating the fielder diving to his left at mid-off
flicked to deep square leg for a single
dropped at third man! Sehwag slashes a short ball from outside off stump, hitting it hard and flat to Levi on the boundary, the ball reached him at head height and he put it down
Pietersen gets smacked on the thigh as he tries to work the ball as it bends back into him after angling across
forced awkwardly towards the non-striker and Pietersen can't get out of the way, the ball hits his pads
Sehwag tries to come out again but mis-hits on the leg side
Sehwag steps out of the crease, Ojha sees him coming and shortens the length, Sehwag is beaten in the flight but adjusts to play the ball to cover
hit hard and flat, forcing KP to duck, towards long on
Sehwag let that one go! It straightened just a bit and was so close to off stump
Ojha's first ball is hit in the air in front of point to the fielder in the deep
Sehwag gets behind the line of a good length ball as it comes into him and defends to the bowler
fuller ball outside off, KP drives to mid off and runs immediately
RP shapes the ball back into Pietersen and hits the back thigh, that's too high for RP Singh's lbw appeal to be upheld
shot! RP slants the ball across the right-hander and Pietersen uses the width to slash behind point, he cut that powerfully
KP's stance is rather square on and he also begins his innings by pulling a short of a length ball through midwicket, he hasn't timed it well

caught at short midwicket! Ojha attempted a pull, but the short of a length ball came back at him, cramping him for room. The ball hit high on the bat and lobbed up for Harbhajan, who ran in a few yards to hold the catch
Sehwag moves back and across and flicks the ball firmly off his pads to the long leg boundary
pulled once again, not as well as the previous ball but he still places it through square leg, the fielder at fine leg has a long run to the ball
that's not that short but the line is straighter and Ojha pulls, swiveling and lofting the ball to the midwicket boundary. There's no fielder there
Ojha has a dab at a short of a length ball outside off, his feet did not go anywhere, neither did the ball
Sehwag stays back and opens the face to steer the ball behind point towards third man
good length and straight, the batsman gets squared up and plays on the off side

Ojha tries to cover drive but the movement back into him results in an inside edge on to the pad. The ball drops at his feet. Ojha begins to run but has to scurry back as RP Singh sprints towards the ball
loud shout for lbw after Ojha comes out of his crease and tries to flick, there was an inside edge on to the pad
defended on the back foot towards the off side
Ojha tries to work the ball square on the leg side but gets beaten and hit on the pad by one that shapes into him
good length on off stump, Ojha stays in his crease and plays to point
too full on the pads, Ojha glances, past the keeper and to the fine-leg boundary
sharp bouncer, and it swings away from the keeper after passing the batsman, Sehwag thought about moving towards the off and hooking, but he let it go in the end
punched off the back foot towards the bowler
tight line and length, around off stump, Sehwag stays in his crease and defends
cut off the back foot towards gully where Rohit dives to his left and makes the save
strays on to the pads this time, Sehwag misses the glance but the ball thuds off the pads and goes past the keeper diving to his left
Sehwag backs away towards leg to make room but Munaf follows him with a good length ball, Sehwag is forced to defend in the end
tries to steer towards third man but gets a bottom edge instead
a third wide down leg side in this over, RP's line is too straight so the movement takes the ball past Ojha's pads
worked off the pads from the crease through square
tucked off the pads behind square after the length ball shapes into the right-hander after angling across him
another one that is down leg side
the ball comes back into the right-hander and Sehwag cuts it from middle-stump line towards third man
Sehwag tries to blaze the ball through cover but gets beaten by a good length ball that slants across him
Sehwag gets hit on the pad as he tries to play one that shapes into him towards square
RP Singh's first ball is down leg side
Sehwag pushes away from his body at a fuller ball outside off stump and edges it towards short third man, where the fielder dives to his left and saves a boundary
good length on off stump, Sehwag stays in his crease and plays towards cover
there are two fielders at backward point, but Sehwag has gone over them, using the width to slash the ball flat over the boundary
short of a length with width outside off stump, Ojha steers towards third man
good length and straighter, Ojha plays the ball close on the off side and begins to run, Sehwag sends him back
good length outside off stump, the target's only 93, so Ojha can afford the luxury of shouldering arms
